احتسبا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَسَبَا (iḥtasabā) /iħ.ta.sa.baː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# اُحْتُسِبَا (uḥtusibā) /uħ.tu.si.baː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# اِحْتَسِبَا (iḥtasibā) /iħ.ta.si.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
